metadata.description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for pessi-mystic — a relentless pessimism and pre-mortem layer for Claude Code that enumerates every way a project, idea, or plan can fail.

plugins.name: pessi-mystic
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin that turns Claude into a relentless pessimist and pre-mortem engine: understands your project/idea/codebase first, then exhaustively enumerates every failure mode and worst-case outcome across a full taxonomy, ranked by likelihood and impact. Pure doom — names what breaks, never how to fix it. Scales from a one-line idea to a whole repo via parallel failure-scouts.
